title: Hands on the corrected bodies
description: The hand's form before and after the body pass's hands part, on a composed woman and man beside the reference: close up hanging, talking, waving, pointing, walking and gathering; full figure; the hand's outline over the reference's; and a man's hand at two sizes beside the reference.
target: A hand built from the reference's measured shares: fingers that fan, slope and taper, a thumb from beside the wrist, at no more triangles or bones than before (docs/CHARACTERS.md, The body: hands). The hand's size is as it was; man-hand-size shows it beside a 20 cm variant for the owner to choose.
